name: elsevier-stream
description: Literature searches in Scopus and ScienceDirect with your Elsevier API key: size a search, save the articles' records with abstracts and references, read them compactly, export citations.

elsevier_api_key.title: Elsevier API key
elsevier_api_key.description: Your key from dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage. Every search needs it. Leave it empty to add it later with /plugin configure, or use one saved with 'elsevier-stream init --api-key'.
